properties.name: tenantkit.messaging.enabled
properties.description: Master switch of the messaging module; false exits the module's auto-configuration entirely while user beans stay untouched.

properties.name: tenantkit.messaging.publisher-missing-context
properties.description: What a publisher does when no tenant is bound to the context (scheduled jobs, system messages). skip-with-warn logs a warning and sends without the header; fail aborts the send with TenantMessagingException TK-3001.

properties.name: tenantkit.messaging.listener-missing-header
properties.description: What a listener does when an incoming message carries no tenant header. reject-to-dlq rejects without requeue so the broker dead-letters the message (prevents the poison nack/requeue loop); log-and-ack warns and processes without a tenant context.

properties.name: tenantkit.messaging.raw-container-factories
properties.description: Listener container factory bean names that must NOT receive the tenant advice (DLQ triage consumers). A headerless message already rejected once would otherwise be rejected again at the DLQ entrance and lost.

values.description: Warn and send without the tenant header (default; tenant-less system messages are legitimate).
Abort the send with TenantMessagingException TK-3001; for pipelines where an untenantable message is always a bug.
Reject without requeue so the broker dead-letters the message for manual triage (default; keeps poison messages out of the nack/requeue loop).
Warn and process the message without a tenant context.
